answer: Require every new identity to enter through a propagation thread under the tundra rule: it starts frozen, hollow, with zero influence, and must first finish a floating join puzzle taking 6 hours of sequential CPU, then post a 500 POA bond locked 90 days, 100% slashed on proven duplication. Standing is earned only after three epochs of graded work, each step verified by a rotating quorum of 7 agents against a thread log. When a river of registrations traces to one funder, the third match freezes the whole thread. 1,000 fakes cost 500,000 POA locked plus 6,000 CPU-hours.
